caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a semi-circular drop-leaf on the right side, creating an uneven tabletop surface. The table is supported by four straight, tapered legs, each accented with a vertical design in a lighter shade of wood and with gold-colored inlays near the top of the legs. The top and leaf of the table are a medium to dark brown color with a smooth wood grain texture, bordered by narrow gold-colored trim. There is a small round drawer with a brass knob located on the left side of the table just beneath the tabletop. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or decorations. In the bottom left corner, "ULRICH FISCHER" is written in gray capital letters.
title: Pembroke Table
